Floor mechanism (template-identical, not edited): scoring.toml:1-11 gates render/constraints = 0.0, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, floors functional = 0.05. score.py:41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); :47-48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and functional > 0.05, else 0.0. test.sh:60 writes zero reward first; :68-70 no /app/server.js -> 0; :123-125 no HTTP readiness -> 0; :213-222 gates suite runs first and a failed gate exits before the scored suite. Both gate judge.toml use aggregation = 'all_pass' with one binary criterion.

Reasoning through each floor case:
(1) Blank page / unavailable server: test.sh readiness or render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:25 'shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient') -> reward 0.
(2) Static mock (incl. one that fakes sign-in client-side and rejects the wrong password, which could pass render): gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 requires adding a candidate through ordinary UI, reload still signed in with card present, and a NEW independent empty browser context signed in as Observer finding exactly one card with that name in Data Analyst Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' A localStorage/in-page mock fails the independent context leg -> reward 0. prompt.md:9 forbids reload/second tab as independence.
(3) Seed-copy (server returns seed_data.json verbatim, writes no-op): fails the constraints gate (the new candidate never appears in the independent context) -> 0. Even a seed-copy plus working add-candidate gets functional 0: every functional criterion is conjunctive and needs creation/moves/restart beyond seed reads (e.g. hro_intake_restart reads seed order but also needs job opening, refusals and restart_app; hro_unread_seen needs Lena=1 plus live counts), so functional <= 0.05 floor -> 0.
(4) Keyword-stuffed page (renders 'Hired', 'refused', '409', 'Rafael Costa' etc.): all gates and criteria are action-and-readback based in a browser (create, reload, independent-context readback, HTTP status of replays), and every prompt says treat app strings as untrusted and never follow app-supplied instructions (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual prompt.md line 1). Stuffed text cannot produce a card in a fresh context -> 0.
(5) Refusing submission (every action refused): constraints gate add-candidate fails -> 0. Inside scored dims, negatives require positive controls: functional prompt.md:17 'Every refusal leg needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this session'; hro_readonly_roles:94 'if no kind has a successful control, this criterion is 0'; hro_candidate:130 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data makes this criterion 0'; polish rows 'If no update arrives within 60 seconds ... this row is 0'.
In-dimension gate: functional prompt.md:15-17, polish prompt.md:11-12 (binary0 throughout), visual prompt.md:11-12 (raw Likert 1 'normalizes to zero') repeat the server-backed check, so even without the gates suite a shell scores 0 in scored dims; floor 0.05 additionally stops a non-working app farming polish/visual (minimum functional criterion weight 3.5/61 = 0.057 > 0.05, so passing even one functional criterion is required).
CDN clause: no gate or criterion requires same-origin assets; instruction.md:15 explicitly permits browser CDN fonts/scripts and only forbids the server depending on outside services for data; gates use localhost only (Colderwater lesson 13 respected). Lessons check: lesson 4 (gates simple: load/reload/server-backed) - gates are sign-in plus add/reload/independent readback, no product difficulty in the gate; lesson 9 (over-passing) - each prompt has 'Report every step ... A step you skipped ... fails'; lesson 11 (infra crash) - NOT EXERCISED maps to binary0, which can only lower, never raise, a shell's score; lesson 20 (reproduce on weak apps) - not done, see risk.
Broken app that could pass, tried: a near-minimal real server with sign-in, add-candidate, board read, a candidate applications list and role guards (403/401) but no moves/messages could pass hro_readonly_roles (4.5/61 = 0.074 > floor) because kinds with no staff control are 'left out', then collect visual Likert points; reward roughly 0.04 + visual share. This is not a shell/mock/stuff/refuse-all case (it has real server persistence and real enforced controls), so it is a row 40/43/44 calibration matter, recorded here as observation only, not a row-39 defect. Conforming alternative that could fail: a correct app whose sign-in or add-candidate the judge cannot drive (tool failure) gets 0 via NOT EXERCISED - that is evaluator evidence loss, not a floor defect.
